rules.credential_query: query or fragment key among access_token, api_key, apikey, auth, auth_token, key, login, loginpas, loginuse, pass, passwd, password, passwort, pwd, token, user, user_name, username, usr (case-insensitive; a published public-API key may be allow-listed per host)
rules.dynamic_dns_host: host under a home dynamic-DNS service (DYNAMIC_DNS_SUFFIXES and DYNAMIC_DNS_PATTERN in scripts/build_webcams.py)
rules.device_path: OpenStreetMap/Wikidata record pointing at a camera device endpoint (axis-cgi, cgi-bin, nph-zms, GetData.cgi, /record/current.jpg, mjpg/, snapshot.cgi, video.cgi, image.jpg?..., ...), also when the endpoint or a camera IP address is embedded in the link's query
rules.nested_urls: a URL carried in a query value is checked by the same rules

privacy_filter.note: Entries name the record, field and rule only: removed URLs and host names are not reproduced.

health_note: A published URL is not verified live. Checks are point-in-time collector-network observations; replay/placeholder imagery and device compatibility require separate assessment.
count_note: Records describe published cameras, views/presets or associated places. They are not a count of distinct physical cameras. URLs are deduplicated in published_urls; shared links never imply identity. External pages authorize no media embedding.
